text:
maria (product): Heads up — AcmeHealth asked for a bundle: 90d trace retention, CSV export for traces/spans, RBAC on observability views/exports, and a per-route cost breakdown in the console. Need to scope MVP and acceptance criteria.

kevin (eng): 90d raw traces will be expensive. Suggest retention tiers + rollup: 30d raw, 90d rolled-up (1d resolution). Also need quotas + opt-in for large tenants.

alex (eng-sre): Multi-tenant exporters are risky. Exports must honor RBAC and be audited. Also rate-limit export jobs to avoid IO storms.

tara (design): CSV export UX idea: a small modal -> choose timeframe + filters -> async export with email/console link. Headers example:
```
timestamp,trace_id,span_id,service,operation,duration_ms,status,host,env,tags
```
Keep modal minimal for MVP. :memo:

sam (devex): Acceptance candidates: user can request export from any filtered view; export generation starts and returns file link; file contains header + respects filters and timezone; generation SLA: <=2m for <=100k spans; export_started/export_completed telemetry emitted.

liz (customer-success): Acme will pilot. They specifically need per-route cost mapping to allocate spend across product teams. Even an estimate is useful.

kevin (eng): Per-route cost is a bigger infra+billing effort — we can approximate for launch by mapping traces to routes and applying model token cost heuristics (estimate). Full token accounting is stretch.

maria (product): Proposal: MVP = retention tiers (30d raw + 90d rollup), CSV export (async) with RBAC+audit for exports, and an "estimated" per-route cost card in the UI. Stretch = precise per-token billing and cold-storage retrieval. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary plan suggested: deploy to prod-us-west canary (5% traffic) for 72h. Rollback if error-rate delta > 1% or 95th latency regress > 15%.

alex (eng-sre): Edge cases to capture in PRD: export cancellation, resumed/failed export retries, very large exports (>1m spans) require admin approval and chunking, filter semantics across rollup boundaries, timezone normalization, CSV escaping for tags/metadata.

maria (product): Owners: Kevin (eng) => infra + retention; Tara (design) => export UX; Sam (devex) => telemetry + docs. @liz please collect pilot acceptance from Acme (SLOs, data retention regs). I'll draft the PRD and post a sync invite for next Wed 10am PT. :calendar: :eyes:

kevin (eng): I'll sketch API surface for export: POST /api/v1/exports/traces { filters, timeframe, format: csv } -> 202 + job_id. Should include `respect_rbac=true` flag server-side.

tara (design): I'll mock modal + export status page. Will include progress + cancel + estimated size.

sam (devex): I'll add CLI example and note telemetry events and acceptance test plan.

maria (product): Great. Quick check: any blockers we need to surface now?

alex (eng-sre): Storage costs + retention SLOs. We'll need to budget and add opt-in for older raw retention. Might require Dedicated customers to enable 90d raw.

maria (product): Noted. I'll include cost/commit gating in PRD. Thanks everyone.
